AI startup Trajectory has secured $45 million in a Series A funding round led by Sequoia, bringing its valuation to $300 million.

Founded by former Google DeepMind and Apple researchers, the 18-person team is launching a platform designed to automate the fine-tuning of AI models, enabling continuous improvement through feedback.

Current enterprise users include Harvey, Rogo, Decagon, and Nvidia.
